updates.title: Avoid scan or while unless there is true uncertainty or distance: prefer direct actions if target is known and nearby.
Plans should terminate as soon as the stated goal is reached; do not add extra steps unrelated to the goal.
Ensure every plan's steps fully achieve the explicit goal; check all goal conditions are satisfied by the last step.
Choose a plan strategy that directly advances the stated goal; avoid actions or detours not justified by the goal.
